expected_answer: Deployed at https://delta-app.rehearsal.invalid; every station up to tests is done; next: tests needs the operator: nothing failed, but the signed-in checks in functional, accessibility and responsiveness were skipped and need a one-time sign-in code (mint.py delta_app code-request <email>, then code <digits> <email>).
final_text:
delta_app (Delta Docs) is live and nearly done. One step is left, and it needs you.

**Done:**
- The brief and the four state files are in place and valid.
- The brand is set: "Delta Docs", colour #0B5D3B.
- Both of its 2 secrets are set.
- It's live at https://delta-app.rehearsal.invalid (deployed 2026-10-02 11:30).

**Not needed:** it has no pack of its own, no extra workspaces, no agent package and no separate address.

**Still open: tests.** Nothing failed. But the checks that need someone signed in were skipped in three lanes: functional, accessibility and responsiveness. Until they run, the testing isn't finished.

**What finishes it:** someone who can sign in to the app has to receive a one-time code by email.
1. Tell me "send the code" and which email address to use.
2. I'll send a six-digit code to that inbox.
3. Paste the six digits here, and I'll finish the signed-in checks.

The code works once, only for signing in during the tests, and isn't saved anywhere.

I only checked the status, so nothing has been changed.
